issues.detail: The Greek 'ελεγον προς εαυτας' (were saying to themselves) is translated as 'nói với nhau' (saying to each other). This changes the internal monologue/private thought of the individuals into a collective outward conversation.

The Greek 'τις αποκυλισει' is an interrogative pronoun ('who') used in a rhetorical or inquisitive sense, but the Vietnamese 'Ai sẽ' (Who will) combined with the added 'sẽ' (future tense/volitional) slightly shifts the nuance of the immediate inquiry, though the primary issue remains the change from internal thought to external speech.
